title: BasicAgent expert capture — not learned-model driving, not Autoware UI

selected_metrics.speed_definition: hypot(recorded ROS rear-axle base_link vx, vy); not XY interval-average speed
selected_metrics.progress_definition: saved independent nearest-route-segment planar arc; no reconstruction or trimming

playback.selection: Every fifth selected anchor, plus final selected anchor; whole fixed 40–120m span
playback.timing: Each GIF delay equals the next retained source timestamp gap rounded to GIF 10ms units

viewport.trajectory: actual saved 20Hz rear-axle trajectory through current frame
viewport.body: QA all_native geometry.body_polygon_carla_xy, converted CARLA y to ROS-map -y

body_geometry.reference_frame: CARLA actor-local; not ROS rear-axle base_link

limitations: One BasicAgent expert capture; no learned model control or Autoware UI was recorded.
All 327 overlapping necessary-check windows are one same-corridor episode, not independent successes.
Clear necessary checks do not approve training data, conversion, model promotion, vehicle control or route completion.
Visual playback is downsampled actual simulator cameras, not a 10Hz playback or runtime-latency measurement.
The 32.6s retained timestamp span is followed by a documented 0.1s final-frame hold in each GIF loop.
